name: hallmark
description: A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated. Powered by Together AI.

interface.shortDescription: Design pages that look made, not AI-generated
interface.longDescription: Hallmark is a design skill for coding agents. It deals themes from a catalog of fifty materials, builds the page around the visitor's job, and lints the result against the tells that read as machine-made. Use it to build a new page, redesign an existing one while keeping content and wiring, or audit a page for Floor and Reflex issues. Powered by Together AI.
defaultPrompt: Build a landing page with Hallmark
